description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Mackerel, Black Gram, Kurakkan etc.
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains a regulatory order that establishes new tax rates on specific commodities, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Finance"), and the primary focus is on regulatory implementation rather than government personnel or structural changes.
